_meta.note: The eight terms defined at their first use in each guide (docs/writing-guide.md > Why lines and the glossary). build.mjs injects id, term, match, caseSensitive and definition as window.__saTerms; src/transform-export.mjs (glossary at point of use) finds each term's first use per guide in the English source, outside [[label]] markers and as a whole word, and renders the definition there. `match` lists the spellings that count as a use; `caseSensitive` is true only for the two acronyms. Each definition is one sentence at Flesch-Kincaid grade 8 or below, and `ledger` lists the Verified claims in docs/claims/claims.json that back it. The term and definition are catalogue strings, translated like any other text on the page: changing one orphans its translation in ten locales. This is not src/i18n/glossary.json, which is IntelliDash terminology for translators and is never shipped. npm run test:shape checks this file.

terms.definition: Volumetric water content: how much of the soil is water, as a percent.
Evapotranspiration: the water your turf and soil lose to the air each day.
The target minus the station’s moisture: the gap the suggestion tries to close.
The amount of water a station applies at 100 percent.
A hole or area row in the table, which shows the average of the rows under it.
Read from a TurfRad moisture scan taken today, and shown in plain black text.
From the model when there was no scan that day, shown in grey italics with a calculator icon.
The VWC you want a station to hold, which you set from 0 to 50 percent.
